feature_name: VSCode Extension Dependency Upgrade and Line Number Fix
description: Upgrade the reactive-vscode dependency to version 1.0.0-beta.1 and fix line number decorations that may have broken due to API changes. The upgrade includes significant improvements to the configuration system and other breaking changes that need to be addressed throughout the extension codebase.
functional_requirements: Update reactive-vscode dependency to v1.0.0-beta.1 in package configuration
Fix line number decoration functionality that may be broken by API changes
Update all usage of reactive-vscode APIs to be compatible with the new version
Ensure the configuration system works with the new defineConfig approach
Test all VSCode extension views (annotations, logger, preview, slides tree) for compatibility
Verify that all composables (dev server, focused slide, server detector) function correctly after the upgrade
